If a qualifying agreement is officially reached before this market’s end date, this market will resolve to “Yes,” regardless of whether the ceasefire agreement officially takes effect after that date.

The primary resolution source for this market will be an official announcement by Ukraine and/or the Russian Federation, however, an overwhelming consensus of credible reporting confirming an agreement has been reached will also qualify.

The National Weather Service guidance points to southerly flow ahead of a weak cold front, with afternoon dew points near 65°F and mostly sunny skies supporting highs in the upper 70s to low 80s. Small differences in the timing and strength of that front between the GFS and ECMWF runs create the near-even split between the 78-79 and 80-81 bins, while historical mid-August normals around 82°F anchor expectations. Overnight model updates and morning surface observations will narrow the range ahead of resolution.
